description:
Implement at most one profile-justified dense-matvec fusion experiment that is distinct from the selected fused AND-popcount route.

## Background

The current AVX2 path already fuses AND with population accumulation, and the generic carry-save comparator is already unselected. If the baseline exposes no distinct material fusion opportunity within budget, the study records a no-candidate result rather than relabelling either established route. Any intrinsic arm retains runtime feature gating plus the tested scalar fallback, and every new unsafe boundary requires an explicit safety contract.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The candidate is traceable to a measured cost center and has shared exact-output coverage for scalar fallback plus aligned, offset, and 0/1/63/64/65 boundary cases.
- [hard] REQ-02: The receipt reports allocated whole-`matvec` samples, adjusted confidence bounds, equivalence results, complexity accounting, annotated release assembly, and profile attribution.
- [hard] REQ-03: The current fused AND-popcount path remains the baseline rather than a new candidate, no production selection changes here, and a no-candidate or losing outcome is preserved.
- [hard] REQ-04: Every new unsafe boundary is isolated to `gf2-kernels-simd` and carries an explicit safety contract covering pointer validity, slice lengths, aliasing, required target features, runtime gating, and scalar fallback reachability.

## Notes

Any intrinsic-bearing experiment must compile and test with Rust 1.95 and remain inside the SIMD kernel crate.
title: Measure the profile-selected matvec fusion
